svg.title: How the pieces come apart
svg.desc: An exploded representative dry kit shows what stays and what can be exchanged.
svg.text: Repeated pitches share a simple face library. Backing, edges and capture stay specific to the duty.
RC and allocated screed / lining. No routine opening.
Fasteners and pressings accessible from the maintenance side.
Prove suitable particles, fire behaviour, compression and creep.
Trial natural timber, selected mineral or formed metal.
Recessed mechanical stop; test closure after each intervention.
Replacement starts with the smallest damaged piece. Keep compatible fixing records and one matching spare.
Match separable backing, pads, clips, finishes and seals to the actual material policy before purchase.
Timing and price require chosen size, quantities, components and mock-up. Labour-sensitive comparisons appear in the owner sheet.
